statement: Let $J$ be a small filtered category, $F:J\to\mathrm{Cat}$ a diagram of small categories, and $V$ a cocone with vertex $C$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let $P_j$ and $Q$ be precoverages on $F(j)$ and $C$. Every transition functor $F(a)$ and cocone functor $V_j$ is continuous for the generated topologies [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Fix $i\in J$ and a abelian sheaf $G$ on $P_i$. Write $I=\mathrm{Under}(i)$, $A_t=F(t.hom)_sG$. For $b:t\to t'$ give a sheaf map $\theta_b:A_t\to F(b.right)^s A_{t'}$ whose composite with the unit $G\to F(t.hom)^s A_t$ equals the unit at $t'$ componentwise as objects of the arrow category of abelian groups. For $t\in I$ let $B_t$ be a presheaf on $C$, with $\beta_t:A_t\to V_t^p B_t$ exhibiting $B_t$ as the left Kan extension of the underlying presheaf of $A_t$ along $V_t^{op}$. Here $V_t=V_{t.right}$, $V_t^p$ is presheaf restriction, and a left Kan extension means that composition with $\beta_t$ bijects maps $B_t\to T$ with maps $A_t\to V_t^p T$ for every presheaf $T$. Let $B:I\to\mathrm{PSh}(C)$ have these objects and satisfy, for all $b:t\to t'$ and $X\in F(t.right)$, $\beta_t(X)B(b)(V_tX)=\theta_b(X)\beta_{t'}(F(b.right)X)$ as objects of $\mathrm{Arrow}(\mathrm{Ab})$.Assume the object and arrow cocones of $V$ are set colimits [def-weil-pbc-arrows-functor]. No covering finiteness or pullback-preservation assumption is imposed. For every $j\in J$, there exist $k\in J$, $a:i\to k$, $b:j\to k$, and a diagram $D:\mathrm{Under}(k)\to\mathrm{Sh}(P_j;\mathrm{Ab})$ such that the presheaf colimit of the underlying presheaves of $D$ is isomorphic to $V_j^{op}\circ\mathrm{colim}\,B$. For every $t=(k\to l)$, the sheaf $D(t)$ is isomorphic to $F(b\circ t)^s(F(a\circ t)_sG)$, where $b\circ t$ and $a\circ t$ mean first $b$ or $a$, then $t$. Thus the restriction of the raw Kan colimit is a filtered colimit of explicitly specified stage sheaves; no separatedness, amalgamation or sheafness of that colimit is asserted. All presheaves and Kan extensions here are abelian.
title: Raw abelian stage restriction as a filtered colimit of stage sheaves

theorem colimit_site_raw_abelian_stage_restriction
    (J : Type u) [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J] (F : J ⥤ Cat.{u, u})
    (P : ∀ j : J, Precoverage (F.obj j))
    [∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k),
      (F.map a).toFunctor.IsContinuous (P j).toGrothendieck (P k).toGrothendieck]
    (V : Cocone F)
    (hobjects : IsColimit (Cat.objects.mapCocone V))
    (harrows : IsColimit (Cat.arrows.mapCocone V))
    (Q : Precoverage V.pt)
    [∀ j : J, (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.IsContinuous
      (P j).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck]
    (i : J) (G : Sheaf (P i).toGrothendieck AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (θ : ∀ (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t'),
                        (sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
                          (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G ⟶
                        ((F.map b.right).toFunctor.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u}
                          (P t.right).toGrothendieck (P t'.right).toGrothendieck).obj
                          ((sheafPullback (F.map t'.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
                            (P i).toGrothendieck (P t'.right).toGrothendieck).obj G))
    (hθ : ∀ (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t'),
      (∀ X : F.obj i,
                          Arrow.mk
                            (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
                              (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).unit.app
                                G).hom.app (op X) ≫
                              (θ t t' b).hom.app (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj X))) =
                          Arrow.mk
                            (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (F.map t'.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
                              (P i).toGrothendieck (P t'.right).toGrothendieck).unit.app
                                G).hom.app (op X))))
    (B : Under i ⥤ (V.ptᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u}))
    (β : ∀ t : Under i,
      ((sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
        (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G).obj ⟶
        (V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.op ⋙ B.obj t)
    (hβ : ∀ t : Under i, (B.obj t).IsLeftKanExtension (β t))
    (hβmap : ∀ (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t') (X : F.obj t.right),
      Arrow.mk ((β t).app (op X) ≫
        (B.map b).app (op ((V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.obj X))) =
      Arrow.mk ((θ t t' b).hom.app (op X) ≫
        (β t').app (op ((F.map b.right).toFunctor.obj X))))
    (j : J) :
    ∃ (k : J) (a : i ⟶ k) (b : j ⟶ k)
      (D : Under k ⥤ Sheaf (P j).toGrothendieck AddCommGrpCat.{u}),
      Nonempty (colimit (D ⋙ sheafToPresheaf (P j).toGrothendieck AddCommGrpCat.{u}) ≅
        (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.op ⋙ colimit B) ∧
      ∀ t : Under k, Nonempty (D.obj t ≅
        ((F.map (b ≫ t.hom)).toFunctor.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u}
          (P j).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj
          ((sheafPullback (F.map (a ≫ t.hom)).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
            (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G))
